mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_message m JOIN ai_conversation c ON m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE c.app_id = #{appId} AND m.role = '1') AS totalQuestions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_conversation WHERE app_id = #{appId}) AS totalConversations, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(m.prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(m.completion_tokens, 0)), 0) FROM ai_message m JOIN ai_conversation c ON m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE c.app_id = #{appId} AND m.role = '2') AS totalTokens, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_message m JOIN ai_conversation c ON m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE c.app_id = #{appId} AND m.role = '1' AND m.create_time >= CURDATE()) AS todayQuestions

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS questions, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(m.prompt_tokens, 0) + COALESCE(m.completion_tokens, 0)), 0) AS tokens FROM ai_message m JOIN ai_conversation c ON m.conversation_id = c.conversation_id WHERE c.app_id = #{appId} AND m.role = '1' AND m.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(m.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date
